title: Rally base tokens
description: The appearance-independent half of the token set: values for registry paths that light and dark share. Same value grammar as a theme file, without the theme metadata.

layer.description: One background layer, written as the kind of source it is rather than as a hand-assembled CSS function.

svg.description: Artwork drawn in the theme file. Percent-encoded into a data URI, so it needs the SVG namespace and it scales like any other image.

url.description: An image fetched over the network. Must be https: — the renderer's Content-Security-Policy allows no other remote scheme.

gradient.description: A CSS gradient function, spelled out.

additionalProperties.description: A literal CSS value, {some.other.token} to alias one, a layer object, or an array of either for a layered background.
